Congratulations to my friend and Northport, Alabama, native Adam Telle on being named Acting Secretary of the Army! 

I’ve been proud to work with Adam to strengthen Alabama’s critical waterways and infrastructure, including securing important investments for Mobile Bay. @POTUS made an outstanding choice and I have tremendous confidence that Adam will lead the @USArmy with distinction.
posts.summary: Praises Trump appointee and celebrates local constituent's advancement

Thrilled to see the House pass the CR with overwhelming bipartisan support and fund the government through December 11, avoiding another senseless shutdown.

There is still more work to do, and we must fund the government through regular order and the appropriations process. I look forward to working with my colleagues to get that done.
posts.summary: Praises bipartisan CR passage, calls for regular appropriations process

I was proud to stand with @POTUS as major technology companies signed the Ratepayer Protection Pledge to ensure the costs of data centers developments are not passed on to consumers. 

This was an outstanding first step to protecting Alabamians and ratepayers across the country, which must be a top priority.

posts.text:
The data on the mental health of our children is gut-wrenching.

Countries like Australia have taken steps to keep children off social media until they are 16 years old. I want us to seriously explore how we can make that work in America, while empowering parents and holding Big Tech accountable.
posts.summary: Calls for social media age restrictions, demands Big Tech accountability
posts.quote:
The data on the mental health of our children is gut-wrenching.

Countries like Australia have taken steps to keep children off social media until they are 16 years old. I want us to seriously explore how we can make that work in America, while empowering parents and holding Big Tech accountable.

posts.text:
I’m glad to see progress, but Meta didn’t make these changes voluntarily. It took attorneys general across the country demanding accountability to achieve this landmark settlement.

This is just a first step. Every platform has a responsibility to put the safety of our children ahead of their profits.
posts.summary: Praises Meta settlement, demands platforms prioritize child safety over profits

posts.text:
21 years ago, Hurricane Katrina devastated the Gulf Coast, leaving destruction and heartbreak in its wake.

Today, we remember all those whose lives were lost or forever changed and honor the incredible strength and resilience Alabamians showed in the aftermath. Their strength, compassion, and determination in the face of tragedy represent the very best of Alabama.
posts.summary: Honors Hurricane Katrina victims, praises community resilience

To be truly pro-life is to protect both baby and mother throughout pregnancy, in the delivery room, and in the years that follow.
